text: Git branching is an important part of version control. A branch lets you work on new ideas without changing the main code. Developers often create feature branches to build a new function or fix a problem safely. When the work is finished, they merge the branch back into the main one. Before merging, teams usually open a pull request so others can review the changes and discuss them. This workflow keeps the project organized and reduces mistakes. By using branches, merging, and pull requests together, teams can work at the same time and keep the main code stable.
